{{Money|1,500}} (Group Bonus) |shared_cash = 50% |music-1 = '''Ambient''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Raid Plan|250px]] |music-2 = '''Final Wave ([[Penumbras]])''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Gatekeeper|250px]] |music-ingame-2 = '''Final Wave ([[Penumbras]])''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Gatekeeper In-Game|250px]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Tower Outskirts''' was the event [[Maps|map]] for the third night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It briefly returned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode and was later removed from the game again, though nothing from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]] was there. Like other event maps, it had a specialized wave structure with special [[enemies]]. Players started with {{Money|1,400}} ({{Money|1,500}} if the player joined Paradoxum Games) at the start of the game. Upon triumphing, you were awarded with {{Coins|150}}, {{Exp|50}}, and {{SolarShard|190 Solar Shards}}. Losing on wave 15 awarded {{Coins|50}}, {{Exp|50}}, and {{SolarShard|150}} instead. This map used the [[Penumbras (Narrator)|Penumbras]] as its narrator, instead of the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]. ==Design & Path== '''Tower Outskirts''' was a map that took place near the gate to a large tower. The tower was grey with large glowing orange windows that were partially covered in vines and leaves, and stone statues. The castle had a drawbridge and a moat around it. Multiple broken houses, watchtowers, fences and obstacles were scattered across the map. It took a curvy turn that went left and right, the path started from the gate outside the tower, and back to the hills. If one can look at '''Tower Outskirts''' more closely, this map took place right next to the [[Totality Tower]]. In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, a majority of the map was invisible, though the objects still remained. The path started at the tower's gate and ends at a cave. It took multiple curvy turns to the left and right until it reached the last curve, where the path became straight. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Tower Outskirts}} ==Story== The [[T.D.S. Organization]] reach the [[Totality Tower]], but are stopped at its outskirts by [[Penumbras]], [[The Umbra]]'s head knight. The [[T.D.S. Organization]] fight the army sent out by the [[Penumbras]] and later [[Penumbras]] himself, defeating him. This allows them to enter the [[Totality Tower]] to face off against [[The Umbra]] herself. ==Rewards== The game calculated how much {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you received based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (08:00 UTC Friday – 08:00 UTC Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 1.5x. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x. Any rewards that ended in a decimal point was rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, there were no rewards. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:0 auto;" !Currency !Equation |- |{{Coins|Coins}} |{{Coins|50}} × (Waves/15)^1.75 + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only) |- |{{Exp|}} |Waves 0-9: {{Exp|1.67}} × Waves
Waves 10-15: {{Exp|3.33}} × Waves |- |{{SolarShard|Solar Shards}} |{{SolarShard|150}} × (Waves/15)^1.75 + {{SolarShard|40}} (Triumph Only) |} ==Event Wave Structure== Formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|220}} + ({{Money|75}} × Waves Completed)) ÷ Players The waves in '''Tower Outskirts''' could not be skipped. ==Event Strategy== *Towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Scout]] and [[Hunter]] are recommended against the first waves, due to their high DPS and early hidden detection. *Towers with high DPS, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] and [[Ranger]] are necessary for this night, due to the enemies having significantly higher health than other nights before it. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can help with boosting the firerate and range of the towers respectively. *Towers that can detect flying enemies, such as the [[Hunter]], [[Ace Pilot]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Ranger]] are necessary, due to the [[Bat (Solar Eclipse)|Bat]] being a flying enemy. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Executioner - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Tower Outskirts''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Tower Outskirts''' in the game trailer. }} ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Tower Outskirts''' added. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Tower Outskirts''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Tower Outskirts''' re-added as a map selectable in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Hard}} to {{Color|Insane}}. **{{Bug}} Large amount of terrain is now invisible. **{{Bug}} '''Tower Outskirts''' Uses the [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] icon in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''8 January 2025''' - [[v1.48.0]] **'''Tower Outskirts''' removed. ==Notes== {{SolarEclipseMaps|[[Foggy Forest]]|Night II|'''Tower Outskirts'''|Night III|[[Totality Tower]]|Night IV}} {{MapNavBox}} [[Category:Event Maps]] [[Category:Hard Maps]] [[Category:Insane Maps]]
